data.headline: Annotation
data.text: The double degree course combines the areas of Management, Business Informatics and Computer Science with the advantages of studying abroad. The aim is to train interdisciplinary experts who can work at the interface of management, IT and computer science and have a broad understanding of complex organisational processes.

data.headline: Admission requirements
data.text:
- First certificate of academic degree in Management, Business Administration, International Relations, Linguistics, Computer Science or related fields with at least 180 ECTS credits.

- Language requirements for non-native speakers:
- English B2
- Language skills in German, Armenian, Georgian, Kazakh, Kyrgyz or Russian of at least level A1

- An interview may be required for admission
